name: regex_syntax
description: The syntax `RLIKE` reads its regular expressions in: `lucene`, the default, or `re2`, the syntax of Go's and so Prometheus' regular expressions. `MV_RLIKE`, `REPLACE` and `GROK` keep their own syntax.
